label: About
title: About The Hood With Nobody Home
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from a saved source, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: a visible mark in the scene opens the real source that shaped the day.

This edition began with one saved post, @ihateguppy: people historically found purpose in their work. but tomorrow, people must wo.... Its image from pbs.twimg.com set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Hood With Nobody Home: Void-hood cinch field: a wide frontal locked-off plate in flat shadowless softbox light on pale grey plaster split by three recessed slate-blue niches. Matte black quilted baffles stretch horizontally across the canvas as stacked pillowed bands, pinched at intervals by thin flecked cords, slack loops dangling between. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped the source to Two ember-red four-point star glints in the black hood void.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
